references.text: God calls Moses to convey His words to the people of Israel, just as Joshua gathers the people to hear the Lord's word.
Moses calls Israel to hear the Lord's commands and statutes, corresponding to Joshua's call for the people to listen to God's word.
The famous Shema text begins with 'Hear, O Israel!' - the same type of call that Joshua gives the people to come and hear the Lord's word.
Moses commands that the people be gathered to hear the law, just as Joshua gathers the people to hear the Lord's word.
Samuel learns to listen to the Lord's word, illustrating the importance of hearing God's speech.
Isaiah calls the people to hear the Lord's word, the same type of call that Joshua gives to Israel.
Faith comes from what is heard, and what is heard comes through the message about Christ - this underscores the importance of listening to God's word.
